_comment: cec-llm-broker registry. Each entry maps an alias (the name clients put in the OpenAI 'model' field) to a docker-compose backend service. The broker starts/stops these ON DEMAND -- never compose up/down an LLM service by hand. vram_gb is the GPU-resident footprint used for arbitration against gpu_budget_gb on the single RTX 5090 (32 GB); when a request would overflow the budget the broker evicts the least-recently-used GPU backend first. Tune vram_gb/gpu_budget_gb if two backends should (or must not) coexist. Backends + filenames mirror docker/compose.yaml in the CEC-Platform repo.

Phase-B migration target -- flip cec_judge_local CEC_VLLM_MODEL_NAME here to use it; WSL cec-worker-vision stays the fallback.
